sloka: स्वस्ति गोब्राह्मणेभ्यस्तु लोकास्तिष्ठन्तु शाश्वताः ।जयतां राघवः सङ्ख्ये रावणं राक्षसेश्वरम् ।। ६.११०.२१ ।।
transliteration: svasti gobrāhmaṇebhyastu lokāstiṣṭhantu śāśvatāḥ ।jayatāṁ rāghavaḥ saṅkhye rāvaṇaṁ rākṣaseśvaram ।। 6.110.21 ।।

translations.english: "May the hosts of sages, Devas, cows and brahmanas be auspicious. May all the worlds endure forever. May Rama conquer Ravana, the Rakshasa king," chanting in that manner all witnessed the terrific war between Rama and Ravana that caused hair to stand.
translations.hindi: इस लड़ाई में उन पन्नग रूपी बाणों को अपने ऊपर गिरते देख श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने सर्पी को भयभीत करने वाले भयानक गरुडासन का प्रयोग किआ
